ثلاثة أرقام → سؤال للذكاء الاصطناعي عن التغيّر والمعلّق → تسجيل قرار واحد.
قراءة خمسين مقالًا تسويقيًا.
approvedReplacementQuiz.explanation: الإيقاع الأسبوعي يبدأ بثلاثة أرقام وسؤال عن التغيّر — ثم قرار واحد مسجّل، لا استجابة عشوائية لكل الرسائل.

approvedReplacementQuiz.question: تريد أتمتة متابعة العملاء المتكررة بعد أول بيع. أي مسار يناسب المهمة؟
options: Builder — بناء تطبيق فورًا.
Automator — أتمتة المتابعة المتكررة.
Creator — محتوى فقط.

approvedReplacementQuiz.question: Ahmed wrote: "Write an email for a new job." What is the most important addition first?
options: Context — who Ahmed is, what the job is, and why this email.
Add more adjectives to make the request sound professional.
Ask the AI to guess Ahmed's background from general knowledge.
approvedReplacementQuiz.explanation: The AI does not know your life. Context plus a clear task turn the request from general to practical.

approvedReplacementQuiz.question: Ahmad, whenever a client agrees to an offer → he manually copies their data from Excel to CRM. What type of pattern is this?
options: Transfer — data from one place to another in the same steps.
Notification — sending an alert when something happens.
Classification — sorting items into categories.
approvedReplacementQuiz.explanation: Copying data from Excel to CRM is a repeated transfer — a clear pattern for the virtual worker.

approvedReplacementQuiz.question: You have four numbers on the dashboard — what is the best first step for automation?
options: Automate the metric you read every week and make a decision — after collecting it manually for two weeks.
Automate all four numbers at once before trying manually.
Build 10 additional charts in Looker Studio.
approvedReplacementQuiz.explanation: Start with the one metric you already read weekly and act on — after two manual weeks that prove it matters.

approvedReplacementQuiz.question: A lead has not replied after your welcome message. What is the best follow-up step?
options: Send the same welcome message again.
A gentle reminder through a different channel or one question — not sales pressure.
Call immediately without any prior reminder.
approvedReplacementQuiz.explanation: Effective follow-up changes the channel and content — a gentle reminder with one question, not a repeated welcome or a surprise call.
